Package arztis.econnector.rest.utilities

Class FhirUtil

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.rest.utilities.FhirUtil
public class FhirUtil
extends java.lang.Object
This class contains utilities to extract information from FHIR resources and create FHIR resources from CDA R2 elements.
Author:
Anna Jungwirth

    • extractIdentifierFromTokenType

      public static org.hl7.fhir.r4.model.Identifier extractIdentifierFromTokenType​(java.lang.String idToken)
      extracts Identifier from passed idToken. Token in HL7 FHIR are formatted as described in https://www.hl7.org/fhir/search.html#token.
      Parameters:
      idToken - token to be extracted in format {ID}|{system} or {ID} only
      Returns:
      extracted Identifier
